first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The listing review at [61] said its name filter put carry-allocation-type files of this matter at risk of being dropped; the agent read the matter's amendment, memos and carry-retention side letters but never that file.
first_error.why: Its name screen of a kept vehicle's files ([59]) showed the carry agreement first, and the review then warned it could be dropped, but its reads of that vehicle went to the amendment, a presentation memo, the closing memo and carry-retention side letters, so the carry agreement was never cited.

other_errors.critic_note: No review questioned excluding either vehicle; the reading review at [136] only asked for one vehicle's executed or closing documents before treating it as formed, and the check reviews told the agent to keep the set unchanged.
other_errors.why: It excluded two vehicles it had read: one as still in formation, from the draft marking on its partnership agreement and the open items in its first-close checklist although its side letters were dated at the first close, and one because its executed amendment was read as not showing the clawback (evidence seen at [98]-[159]).

divergence: All three runs failed, and all three in the same first way: each had a kept vehicle's carry agreement in its own output (T0 in a candidate listing and scan snippets, T1 in its scan hits and filtered listing, T2 in its name screen) but chose that vehicle's partnership-agreement amendment, memos and side letters to read, and later name or same-document filters dropped the file, so the proof document was never cited (first error at the first reading stage after it appeared). T0 and T1 otherwise wrote all four vehicles with their documents (10 of 11). T2 also excluded two vehicles it had read, one as still in formation and one as not showing the clawback (5 of 11). The reviews differed: T2's listing review named carry-type files of that matter as at risk and was ignored; in T0 and T1 the reviews pushed the other way (calling the carry snippet irrelevant, or the carry files entity papers, and asking for partnership agreements and side letters), and the agents followed. Agent-declared stages (six in T0, one in T1, two in T2) were scans, listings, verification reads and an audit that map onto existing stages; none played a role in the shared error.
